entries.definition: Internet slang (Oxford Word of the Year 2024; metaphorical roots in Thoreau's 1854 Walden) covering four closely linked meanings in contemporary digital culture: (1) Low-value, hyper-stimulating, absurd or repetitive online media (short-form vertical feeds, doomscrolling loops, Gen Z / Gen Alpha slang chains like Skibidi, Ohio, rizz, sigma, Fanum tax) and the attention-fried, numbed mental state attributed to overconsuming it. (2) Cringey AI-generated slop videos flooding Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, especially the 2025-2026 'Italian Brainrot' wave: uncanny generative-AI hybrids of animals, food, vehicles and objects paired with rhythmic autotuned or TTS pseudo-Italian chants and mock soap-opera lore. (3) The collectible AI meme characters themselves ('brainrots' / 'брейнроты' / 'бреинроты'), such as Tralalero Tralala (three-legged shark in Nike sneakers), Ballerina Cappuccina (ballerina with a cappuccino mug for a head), Cappuccino Assassino (coffee-cup ninja), Bombardiro Crocodilo (crocodile-bomber plane hybrid), Tung Tung Tung Sahur (anthropomorphic wooden log with a bat, rooted in Indonesian Ramadan sahur culture), Brr Brr Patapim, Chimpanzini Bananini, Lirili Larila, Trippi Troppi and Bombombini Gusini. (4) Mass-produced, creatively empty, conveyor-belt slop games in Roblox and mobile stores (exemplified by the 2025 Roblox hit 'Steal a Brainrot' and endless asset-flipped clones), where rare brainrot characters roll down a conveyor belt for players to buy, farm passive cash, hatch/merge, and steal from other players' bases in repetitive dopamine-trap loops. По-русски: брейнрот / бреинрот - это и «гниение мозга» от тупых рилзов/шортсов, и кринжовые ИИ-видосы с персонажами вроде Балерины Капучины и Тралалеро Тралала, и конвейерные слоп-игры в Roblox про сбор и кражу бреинротов с конвейера.
entries.clarification: Not a literal medical or neurological condition, and not LLM 'context rot' (model degradation over long context windows). Plural forms ('brainrots', 'брейнроты', 'бреинроты') frequently denote the AI-generated meme characters or in-game collectible units in Roblox/mobile clones, while the singular can mean the mental fatigue, the absurdist AI-reel subgenre, or derivative conveyor-belt slop games. Distinct from broader 'AI slop', which also applies to unreviewed AI text, code and pull requests.

entries.definition: In modern internet, TikTok/Reels edit and gaming culture, Funk (also called Brazilian Funk or Brazilian Phonk) is a major subgenre/branch of Phonk rooted in Brazilian funk carioca (baile funk). Unlike Memphis-rap drift phonk, it uses syncopated Brazilian percussion swing, heavily distorted 808 sub-bass, aggressive clipping, chopped Portuguese MC vocals and cowbells for drift, anime, gym and gaming edits. Key subgenres include: (1) Montagem (MTG) - sonic collage stitching chopped vocal hooks, MC chants, sirens and sharp bass drops over rolling loops (tracks prefixed with Montagem or MTG). (2) Montacraft (Minecraft Funk) - viral micro-genre fusing Montagem/funk phonk drops with Minecraft sound effects (block breaks, mob sounds, eating, item pickups, ambient notes). (3) Automotivo (Funk Automotivo) - extreme blown-out sub-bass and hypnotic loops built for Brazilian car audio setups (paredoes). (4) Mandelão (Funk Mandelão) - raw, minimalist Sao Paulo street-party (baile/fluxo) rhythm foundation with echoing bass drops and clicks. (5) Bruxaria - dark, occult/horror-tinged style with eerie vocal chops and sinister loops. (6) Krushfunk - aggressively clipped, bit-crushed high-energy funk phonk for fast edits. (7) Mega Funk - multi-layered club/sound-system medleys cycling through hooks and tempo shifts. (8) Submundo - gritty, brooding underground style blending dark Memphis-style vocals with heavy distorted sub-bass. (9) Ritmadinha - faster, bouncy vocal-hook style for short-form dance/edit trends. (10) Other branches such as Funk Rave (EDM/rave crossover), Funk Proibidão (gritty favela lyricism), Jumpstyle Funk (fusion with European four-on-the-floor jumpstyle), Slap Funk, Funk Sigilo and Funk Pesadão. Tracks are routinely released in viral remix/edit packs: Slowed, Slowed + Reverb, Super Slowed and Ultra Slowed (lowered tempo/pitch with deep reverb for dark booming bass); Sped Up / Nightcore (faster, higher-pitched cuts); Rock and Metal / Guitar versions (distorted electric guitar riffs, live/metal drums and breakdowns over the funk beat); Bass Boosted / Overdriven (pushed sub-bass and clipping); 8D Audio (left-right spatial panning); Muffled / Underwater (heavy low-pass filter); Instrumental, Acapella, Extended and Seamless Loop edits; plus cross-genre Mashups, Hardstyle, Jersey Club and VIP remixes. По-русски: фанк (бразильский фанк / бразильский фонк) в современном интернет-контексте - это жанр фонка с перегруженным басом и бразильскими ритмами для эдитов в TikTok/Reels, его поджанры (Montagem, Montacraft, Automotivo, Mandelão, Bruxaria, Krushfunk, Mega Funk, Submundo, Ritmadinha, Jumpstyle Funk и др.) и форматы ремиксов (слоуд, слоуд + реверб, супер/ультра слоуд, спидап/найткор, рок- и метал-версии с электрогитарой, басс-буст, 8D, muffled, инструментал, мешапы).
entries.clarification: In music history, 'funk' also denotes classic 1960s-1970s American funk (James Brown, Parliament-Funkadelic, groove/disco bass). Use prompt context (phonk, edits, TikTok/Reels, slowed/reverb, gym/drift/gaming montages, or subgenre names like Montagem, Montacraft, Automotivo, Mandelão) to distinguish modern phonk-branch Funk from classic American funk. Outside music, 'MTG' usually refers to Magic: The Gathering.

entries.definition: An internet music and aesthetic cluster spanning Dreamcore, Weirdcore, Liminal space music and Backrooms/Poolrooms versions. It evokes bittersweet, uncanny nostalgia (anemoia - longing for a remembered place or era that never quite existed) linked to empty transitional environments such as vacant malls, fluorescent office corridors, tiled poolrooms, solitary green hills under bright skies, and hazy late-1990s / early-2000s memories. Signature sound design combines simple, repetitive, slightly detuned melodies (music box, toy piano, Rhodes, soft sine pads, indie or lo-fi vocal loops) with vast hall/convolution reverb, heavy low-pass muffling (as if heard through walls or water), VHS/cassette tape saturation with pitch wow and flutter, and subtle environmental foley (60 Hz fluorescent light hum, distant HVAC drones, dripping water echoes, hollow mall PA ambience). Key sub-variants and remix labels: (1) Dreamcore version - warm, hazy, dreamlike slowed/reverbed/detuned reworks of nostalgic indie, ambient or lo-fi tracks (e.g. 7 Weeks & 3 Days Dreamcore Version, Instupendo, Oneheart). (2) Backrooms / Poolrooms version - darker, cavernous, isolated remixes drowned in decay, muffling and fluorescent-hum or wet-tile acoustics (e.g. 7 Weeks & 3 Days Backrooms Version, The Caretaker-style plunderphonics). (3) Weirdcore - more unsettling, pairing innocent melodies with abrupt silences, digital glitches and reverse sweeps. (4) Mallsoft / Liminal ambient - vaporwave-adjacent slowed elevator/shopping-mall soundscapes and warm isolating synth drones. По-русски: лиминальная и дримкор-музыка (Dreamcore / Weirdcore / Backrooms / Poolrooms версии) - это треки и ремиксы с ощущением тревожной ностальгии и пустых переходных пространств: замедленные, приглушённые, утопленные в ревербе и VHS-деградации мелодии (часто с фоновым гулом ламп или эхом пустого бассейна/ТЦ).
entries.clarification: Distinguish internet liminal/dreamcore music and remix labels like '(Dreamcore Version)' or '(Backrooms Version)' from Victor Turner's anthropological concept of liminality, generic sleep/meditation ambient, or traditional 1990s dream pop/shoegaze. In music, video-edit, game or UI-atmosphere prompts, these terms denote the uncanny-nostalgic, reverbed, muffled, transitional-space aesthetic.

entries.definition: A short, high-impact, rhythm-driven audiovisual montage (typically 5-45 seconds for TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts) crafted from existing footage - films, series, cars, anime, sports, gaming captures or 3D renders - synced frame-by-frame to music (often phonk/funk, slowed+reverb, electronic or cinematic tracks). Crucially, a real edit is NOT a cartoon, NOT traditional character animation, and NOT a low-effort slideshow template: its power comes from editing craft, pacing, kinetic flow and visceral audiovisual punch. High-craft edits (built in Adobe After Effects, Blender, Cinema 4D or Alight Motion; exemplified by benchmark creators like Zlusha in the CIS/Russian AE editing school or top Reels editors like ajet) rely on: (1) Exact beat sync and custom Graph Editor curves so every cut, zoom and movement snaps with physical weight onto bass drops and snares. (2) Velocity / speed ramping with optical-flow slow-motion (Twixtor) and realistic motion blur (RSMB). (3) Seamless camera choreography - 3D camera whips, zooms, match cuts, rotoscoping/masking reveals, parallax depth and 3D scene compositing. (4) Cinematic color grading (CC), glow/halation, directional camera shakes (e.g. Sapphire) and layered SFX (whooshes, risers, impacts) that make transitions breathtaking. По-русски: эдит (настоящий AE/3D-эдит уровня Злуши или ajet) - это не мультик, не анимация и не школьное слайдшоу, а захватывающий дух короткий монтаж из готовых кадров/3D-сцен с ювелирной синхронизацией в бит, велосити (Twixtor + RSMB), бесшовными 3D-переходами камеры, шейками, масками, цветокором и SFX.
entries.clarification: Do not confuse a video edit ('эдит') with a cartoon ('мультик'), standalone narrative animation, generic slideshow, or the software/coding verb 'edit' (modifying source files). When a user references edits, Zlusha or edit-style visuals/motion, they mean high-craft beat-synced montage, snappy velocity curves, seamless camera transitions, cinematic color grading and kinetic impact.
